reasons.text: The sampled forum posts nominate Brummell and Aces Wild, but provide neither a price nor a form explanation. That does not justify promoting either into a recommendation.
There may be better-supported opinions elsewhere. This is a limited reviewed sample, not a finding that every horse is poor value.
A nomination or agreement count cannot replace form analysis and an obtainable price.
